description: This file contains utility functions for managing and processing artifacts during CI/CD workflows, especially related to PyTorch repositories. Functions include downloading artifacts from GitHub and S3, uploading data to DynamoDB and S3, unzipping files, and checking whether rerun-disabled tests are present.

methods.name: Any get_s3_resource()
methods.description: Returns the cached AWS S3 resource object.

methods.name: dict[str,str] _get_request_headers()
methods.description: Constructs headers for GitHub API requests, including authorization token.

methods.name: dict[Path,str] _get_artifact_urls(prefix: str, workflow_run_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches URLs for artifacts with specific prefix from GitHub Actions API.

methods.name: Path _download_artifact( artifact_name: Path, artifact_url: str, workflow_run_attempt: int )
methods.description: Downloads a specific artifact from its URL, ensuring correct run attempt.

methods.name: list[Path] download_s3_artifacts( prefix: str, workflow_run_id: int, workflow_run_attempt: int, job_id: int | None = None, )
methods.description: Downloads artifacts from an S3 bucket matching a prefix and optional job ID.

methods.name: list[Path] download_gha_artifacts( prefix: str, workflow_run_id: int, workflow_run_attempt: int )
methods.description: Downloads artifacts from GitHub Actions based on a prefix and workflow run ID.

methods.name: None upload_to_dynamodb( dynamodb_table: str, repo: str, docs: list[Any], generate_partition_key: Callable[[str, dict[str, Any]], str] | None, )
methods.description: Uploads a list of documents to a DynamoDB table, with optional partition key generation.

methods.name: None upload_to_s3( bucket_name: str, key: str, docs: list[dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Uploads a list of JSON documents, gzipped, to a specified S3 bucket and key.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] read_from_s3( bucket_name: str, key: str, )
methods.description: Reads and decompresses gzipped JSON objects from S3.

methods.name: Any remove_nan_inf(old: Any)
methods.description: Converts NaN and infinite float values in data structures to strings for valid JSON.

methods.name: None upload_workflow_stats_to_s3( workflow_run_id: int, workflow_run_attempt: int, collection: str, docs: list[dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Uploads workflow statistics to S3 in specified collection and directory structure.

methods.name: None upload_file_to_s3( file_name: str, bucket: str, key: str, )
methods.description: Uploads a local file directly to S3.

methods.name: Path unzip(p: Path)
methods.description: Extracts a zip file to a directory and returns the directory path.

methods.name: bool is_rerun_disabled_tests( report: Path, workflow_run_id: int, workflow_run_attempt: int, tests: dict[str, dict[str, int]], )
methods.description: Determines if the test report comes from rerun-disabled-tests workflow based on test counts.

methods.name: int|None get_job_id(report: Path)
methods.description: Extracts job ID from a report path.

methods.name: str|None get_job_name( id: int | None, workflow_id: int | None, workflow_run_attempt: int | None )
methods.description: Fetches the job name for a given job ID, workflow ID, and attempt number from GitHub API.
